info.title: Starlinks API
info.summary: Smart links, pre-saves and promo images for distributors.
info.description:
Give your artists and labels smart links, pre-saves, analytics and promo images under your own brand, inside your own platform.

## Choose how to integrate

You can use either option, or both together.

| Compare | **Option 1: Embed (iframe)** | **Option 2: API** |
|---|---|---|
| **What it is** | Our link creator, inside a page of your platform | Your server creates and manages links |
| **Developer work** | Paste one snippet (no backend needed) | Build calls to the REST API (and optionally webhooks) |
| **Who creates links** | Your users, themselves | Your platform, automatically (e.g. when a release is delivered) |
| **Your users get** | Search by artist/title, UPC, ISRC or store link; release or pre-save links; promo images; analytics; My links | Links created for them, emailed with their promo images |
| **Best for** | Launching in minutes | Full automation and syncing with your catalogue |

Both use your branding (logo, colors, font, and your own link domain once connected), and the links they create appear in your distributor portal. Get your embed code and API key in the portal once your distributor account is approved.

# Option 1: Embed (iframe)

## Set up the embed

1. In your portal, under **Embed code**, copy your code: it already contains your embed key.
2. Under **Branding & embed domains**, list every domain where you'll place it (for example `app.yourplatform.com`). The embed only loads on those domains.
3. Paste the code into the page of your platform where your users should create smart links.

```html
<iframe id="starlinks-embed" src="https://www.starmakersdistro.com/embed/<your embed key>" title="Create a smart link" width="100%" height="900" style="border:0;border-radius:16px;max-width:1100px" loading="lazy" allow="clipboard-write; web-share"></iframe>
<script>
  window.addEventListener("message", function (event) {
    if (event.origin !== "https://www.starmakersdistro.com" || !event.data || event.data.type !== "starlinks:resize") return;
    document.getElementById("starlinks-embed").style.height = event.data.height + "px";
  });
</script>
```

- The small script resizes the frame to fit its content (the embed posts `{ type: "starlinks:resize", height }`). Without it, the frame keeps its 900px height and scrolls.
- `allow="clipboard-write; web-share"` lets users copy their link and share promo images straight to apps on phones.
- Once your custom domain is connected, the portal's code uses it instead of www.starmakersdistro.com.

## What your users can do in the embed

- Find their release by **artist and title**, or paste a **UPC, ISRC or store link**; we fill in the store links, artwork and artist photo.
- Choose a **release link** (out now) or a **pre-save link** (countdown and pre-save buttons, switching to play links on release day).
- Copy their link and QR code, and download **promo images** (Story, Square, Wide).
- Leave an email to get their link, a private edit link and the promo images by email.
- With account linking on, see and edit all their links, with analytics, under **My links**.

## Account linking (optional)

Turn on account linking in the portal so your signed-in users see their links under **My links** in the embed, without emailed edit links. Your server signs the user's id and an expiry (at most 7 days ahead) with the account secret from the portal, and adds `uid`, `exp` and `sig` to the embed address. Unsigned or expired requests are refused. Links you create through the API with the same `owner_uid` appear there too.

Node.js:

```js
const crypto = require("crypto");

const uid = String(user.id); // your user's id
const exp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 24 * 60 * 60; // valid 24 hours
const sig = crypto.createHmac("sha256", process.env.STARLINKS_SECRET).update(`${uid}.${exp}`).digest("hex");
const src = `https://www.starmakersdistro.com/embed/<your embed key>?uid=${encodeURIComponent(uid)}&exp=${exp}&sig=${sig}`;
// <iframe id="starlinks-embed" src={src} ...></iframe>
```

PHP:

```php
<?php
$uid = (string) $user->id; // your user's id
$exp = time() + 24 * 60 * 60; // valid 24 hours
$sig = hash_hmac('sha256', $uid . '.' . $exp, getenv('STARLINKS_SECRET'));
$src = 'https://www.starmakersdistro.com/embed/<your embed key>?uid=' . rawurlencode($uid) . '&exp=' . $exp . '&sig=' . $sig;
?>
<iframe id="starlinks-embed" src="<?= htmlspecialchars($src) ?>" ...></iframe>
```

Python:

```python
import hashlib, hmac, os, time
from urllib.parse import quote

uid = str(user.id)  # your user's id
exp = int(time.time()) + 24 * 60 * 60  # valid 24 hours
sig = hmac.new(os.environ["STARLINKS_SECRET"].encode(), f"{uid}.{exp}".encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
src = f"https://www.starmakersdistro.com/embed/<your embed key>?uid={quote(uid)}&exp={exp}&sig={sig}"
```

Sign on your server only: never put the account secret in browser code. User ids may contain letters, numbers and `_ . @ : + -`, up to 128 characters.

# Option 2: API

## API quickstart

1. Once your distributor account is approved, you get a link to set your portal password.
2. In your portal, add your branding and, under **API**, create a key. Copy it when it's shown: we only keep a hash.
3. Create your first link. With a UPC, we find the stores, the artwork and the artist photo:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://starlinks.starmakersdistro.com/api/v1/links" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STARLINKS_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "upc": "196871234567",
    "release_date": "2026-11-20T00:00:00Z",
    "owner_email": "artist@example.com"
  }'
```

The response has the link's `url`, its `share_images` and its `state`. A future `release_date` makes a pre-save page with a countdown that switches to play links on release day. With `owner_email`, the artist gets an email with their link, a private edit link and promo images.

## Authentication, limits and errors

- **Authentication:** send your API key as `Authorization: Bearer slk_<partner id>_<secret>`. Keep it on your server: the API sends no CORS headers, so browsers can't call it. Making a new key in the portal stops the old one straight away.
- **Limits:** 1,000 requests an hour per distributor (`429` when exceeded), plus your daily link-creation limit.
- **Idempotency:** creating a link for a UPC/ISRC that already has one returns that link (`existing: true`), so retries never duplicate links.
- **Errors:** every error is JSON `{ "error": "message" }` with a meaningful status code.

## Webhooks

Set your HTTPS address and choose events in the portal, under **Webhooks**. Each event is a `POST` with a JSON body:

```json
{
  "id": "whd_mgvq3k2a_5f1c9e2b",
  "type": "link.released",
  "created_at": "2026-11-20T00:04:12.000Z",
  "data": { "link": { "id": "…", "url": "…", "state": "live", "artist_name": "…", "release_title": "…", "stores": { } } }
}
```

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `link.created` | A link was created (`data.source`: `embed`, `portal` or `api`). |
| `link.updated` | A link was edited (`data.source`: `portal`, `api` or `creator`). |
| `link.deleted` | A link was deleted (`data.link` is the link as it was). |
| `link.released` | A pre-save link's release date passed and it now shows play links. Sent once. |
| `link.stores_found` | A re-scan found more stores (`data.added` maps each new store field to its link). |
| `presave.added` | A fan pre-saved (`data.channel`: `email`, `spotify`, `apple`, `tidal` or `youtube`). Fans' identities are never sent. |
| `ping` | The test event from the portal. |

**Delivery.** Reply with any `2xx` within 3 seconds. Anything else is retried after 1, 5 and 30 minutes, then 2, 6 and 12 hours. The portal lists recent deliveries, lets you resend them, and sends test events. The `id` is the same on every retry, so you can ignore duplicates.

**Verify every request.** Each request has the headers `Starlinks-Event`, `Starlinks-Delivery` and `Starlinks-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`, where `v1` is HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` with the signing secret from your portal. Compare in constant time and reject timestamps older than 5 minutes.

Node.js (Express):

```js
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import express from "express";

// Check the signature against the raw body, before parsing it.
function verifyStarlinks(rawBody, header, secret) {
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(header.split(",").map((part) => part.split("=")));
  const t = Number(parts.t);
  if (!t || Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - t) > 300) return false; // older than 5 minutes
  const expected = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(`${t}.${rawBody}`).digest();
  const given = Buffer.from(parts.v1 || "", "hex");
  return given.length === expected.length && crypto.timingSafeEqual(given, expected);
}

const app = express();
app.post("/webhooks/starlinks", express.raw({ type: "application/json" }), (req, res) => {
  const ok = verifyStarlinks(req.body.toString("utf8"), req.get("Starlinks-Signature") || "", process.env.STARLINKS_WEBHOOK_SECRET);
  if (!ok) return res.sendStatus(400);
  const event = JSON.parse(req.body);
  // event.id stays the same on retries: skip ids you've already handled.
  res.sendStatus(200);
});
```

PHP:

```php
<?php
$raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
parse_str(str_replace(',', '&', $_SERVER['HTTP_STARLINKS_SIGNATURE'] ?? ''), $parts);
$t = (int) ($parts['t'] ?? 0);
$expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $t . '.' . $raw, getenv('STARLINKS_WEBHOOK_SECRET'));

if (abs(time() - $t) > 300 || !hash_equals($expected, $parts['v1'] ?? '')) {
    http_response_code(400);
    exit;
}
$event = json_decode($raw, true);
http_response_code(200);
```

Python (Flask):

```python
import hashlib, hmac, os, time
from flask import Flask, request, abort

def verify_starlinks(raw: bytes, header: str, secret: str) -> bool:
    parts = dict(part.split("=", 1) for part in header.split(",") if "=" in part)
    t = int(parts.get("t", "0") or 0)
    if abs(time.time() - t) > 300:  # older than 5 minutes
        return False
    expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), f"{t}.".encode() + raw, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, parts.get("v1", ""))

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.post("/webhooks/starlinks")
def starlinks():
    if not verify_starlinks(request.get_data(), request.headers.get("Starlinks-Signature", ""), os.environ["STARLINKS_WEBHOOK_SECRET"]):
        abort(400)
    event = request.get_json()
    return "", 200
```

# Both options

## Pre-saves, store links and promo images

- **Pre-saves:** a link with a future `release_date` shows a countdown and pre-save buttons for Apple Music (Pre-add), Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer, TIDAL and Amazon Music. Apple Music, Spotify, TIDAL and YouTube Music fans sign in and the release is saved to their library on release day, found by UPC/ISRC if the store has no link yet (`presave_stores` lists which are switched on). Deezer and Amazon Music fans pre-save by email and get that store's link on release day (`presave_email_stores`), until the store publishes its own pre-release page. Any fan can also just ask for a release-day email. On the release date the page switches to play links by itself, and `link.released` fires.
- **Store links:** found from the UPC, ISRC or store link through each store's official API, accepting exact matches only. Stores that publish the release later are added automatically (`link.stores_found`).
- **Promo images:** each published link has three PNGs in `share_images`: Story (1080×1920), Square (1080×1080) and Wide (1200×630), with your logo, the cover over the artist's photo, the stores, the link and a QR code. They always show the current details.
- **Analytics:** views, store clicks and pre-saves by day, store, country, device and traffic source: `GET /links/{id}?stats=30`.

## Changelog

**October 2026**

- Pre-saves on every major store: Apple Music (Pre-add), Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer, TIDAL and Amazon Music; `presave_email_stores` on pre-save links and `store` on `presave.added`.
- 15-second promo videos (Story and Square) in the embed, portal and edit pages.

- Webhooks: link created, updated, deleted, release day, new stores found, and pre-saves, signed with HMAC-SHA256 and retried for about a day.
- `GET /search` and `GET /artists/{ref}/releases` to find the exact release by artist and title.
- `share_images` on every published link, and `presave_stores` on pre-save links.
- Artists who give an email get their promo images with their link.
- The embed resizes itself, and promo images can be shared straight to apps from phones.
- These docs now cover both integrations: the embed (iframe) and the API.
- REST API v1: create (idempotent by UPC/ISRC), list, get with analytics, update, delete.
- Store pre-saves on Spotify, Apple Music, TIDAL and YouTube Music.
- Ad pixels (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads, Snapchat) on fan pages, with cookie consent.

Questions: support@starmakersdistro.com

post.description:
Creates a link from a UPC, ISRC or store link (`url`); store links, names, artwork and the artist photo are filled in from the stores. A future `release_date` makes a pre-save link that switches to play links on that date.

**Idempotent by UPC/ISRC:** sending a release that already has a link returns that link with `existing: true` and status 200, so retries never create duplicates.

If the stores don't have the release yet, send `artist_name` and `release_title` too.

With `owner_email`, the artist is emailed their link, a private edit link and promo images (Story, Square, Wide).

200.description: This release already had a link: returned unchanged.

400.description: Invalid input (for example a store link on the wrong domain).

422.description: Release not found in the stores (send artist_name and release_title), or pre-save links are turned off.

429.description: Hourly request limit or daily link limit reached.

get.description: One link. Pre-save links include `presave_stores`. Add `?stats=<days>` (1-365) for analytics.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.description: Include this many days of analytics.

patch.description: Partial update: fields you don't send keep their values. Send `published: false` to take a link offline (draft) and `true` to publish it again. Changing `release_date` to the future makes it a pre-save link again.

delete.description: Deletes the link; its address stops working.

get.description: Finds artists, albums and tracks by artist name and/or title (Spotify, or Deezer when Spotify isn't available). Create the link with the chosen album or track's `url`.

release_title.description: Release title shown on the page.

release_date.description: Release date and time (ISO 8601). Pre-save pages switch to play links at this time.

owner_email.description: The artist's email, if given (they received their link and promo images).

owner_uid.description: Your user's id, if given (account linking / My links).

updated_at.description: When the link was last changed.
